MAINTENANCE · Suspension & Chassis

Wheel Alignment in Riyadh

Wheel alignment for luxury and performance cars in Riyadh: pulling, uneven tyre wear and off-centre steering corrected to manufacturer geometry values.

  1. Home
  2. Maintenance
  3. Wheel Alignment

Alignment on a luxury or performance car is measurement work: manufacturers specify geometry values per model, suspension option and ride height, and small deviations show up as pulling, wander, an off-centre wheel, or tyres scrubbed away in a few thousand kilometres. QSC measures against the manufacturer's values for your specific configuration and corrects to specification — and checks why the geometry moved, because alignment that keeps drifting usually means a worn or bent component underneath.

PHOTO PENDING — WHEEL ALIGNMENT

When to book this service

  • The car pulls to one side on a flat road
  • Steering wheel off-centre when driving straight
  • Uneven or rapid tyre wear, especially inner or outer edges
  • After hitting a kerb or pothole, or after suspension repairs

How QSC handles it

Geometry measurement against the manufacturer's values for your exact model and options

Inspection of steering and suspension components that influence alignment

Adjustment of all adjustable angles to specification

Before/after measurement printout and a road check

Frequently asked questions

How often does alignment need checking?

There is no fixed interval — check after impacts, with new tyres, after suspension work, or whenever the symptoms above appear. An annual check is a reasonable habit on Riyadh roads.

Why does my alignment keep going out?

Repeatedly drifting geometry usually points to worn bushes, links or a bent component. QSC inspects for that before adjusting, because aligning on worn parts does not hold.

Does lowering or air suspension change alignment?

Yes — geometry values depend on ride height. Vehicles with adjustable or air suspension are measured at the correct reference height for their specification.
